title: Index
description: One document of the index ledger (collection indexes, in the Chunk Store's database): what one embedding fingerprint built, and how a query must be embedded against it. Written once by the embedding step when it first prepares the index of its fingerprint; read by the query-api role, which takes the collection, the model and the query prefix from it rather than from its own settings, so index and query never embed differently.

_id.description: The embedding fingerprint: the identifier of the index.

collection.description: Collection of the Search Index holding the points: chunks_<fingerprint>.

model.description: The embedding model, as the backend names it, and the digest of its bytes.

chunking_fingerprint.description: Chunking fingerprint accepted; null when any.

document_prefix.description: Put before a chunk's text when it was embedded.

query_prefix.description: To put before a query when it is embedded against this index.

image.description: Digest of the service image that prepared the index, when known.

datetime.description: UTC timestamp. Stored as a BSON date; rendered as RFC 3339 in JSON samples.
